name: Charles F. Adams
title: Associate Justice, California Court of Appeal, Sixth Appellate District
district: Sixth Appellate District (Santa Clara, Santa Cruz, Monterey, and San Benito counties)
years_of_service: Santa Clara County Superior Court 2018 to 2026; Sixth District Court of Appeal since August 6, 2026. (Court of Appeal bio)
background: Adams was born and raised in Antioch. He earned a B.A. in American Studies and Spanish from UC Davis (2000) and a J.D. from Pepperdine University School of Law (2003). (Court of Appeal bio)

He practiced family law in Southern California (Voss & Associates; McDermott & McNamara, 2003 to 2006), was a staff and legal research attorney at the Santa Clara County Superior Court (2006 to 2011), and was administrative law clerk to U.S. District Judge Edward J. Davila in the Northern District of California (2011 to 2018). (Governor's office; Court of Appeal bio)

As a Santa Clara County Superior Court judge from 2018 he sat in the criminal, civil, family, probate, and appellate divisions and supervised the Family Division (2021 to 2023). Gov. Newsom nominated him to the Sixth District in June 2026 and he was confirmed August 6, 2026. (Court of Appeal bio)
